chunks: 1957 - The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Suhoor is a blessing.”
And he عليه السلام said: “My Ummah should not abandon suhoor, even if it is only upon a single dried date.”

key_terms.أُمَّتِيَ: my community, referring to the followers of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.اَلسَّحُورُ: the pre-dawn meal eaten before the fast begins
key_terms.بَرَكَةٌ: a source of blessing and divine good
key_terms.حَشَفَةِ: a dried and inferior date; here indicating even a very small amount

ai.seo_question: Why is suhoor recommended in Islam even if one only has a small amount to eat?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that suhoor, the pre-dawn meal before fasting, carries barakah. It encourages the Ummah not to neglect suhoor, even if the amount is very small, such as a single dried date.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1957 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Suhoor (the pre-dawn meal) is a blessing."
He (sw) also said: "My Ummah should not abandon suhoor, even if it is just a single piece of dried date."
